skills.name: You Can Only Risk Death While You're Still Alive!!

skills.detail: While the skill button is held down, damage received from enemies is reduced, and you are able to move. Unleashes a long-range area attack with a chance to Stun after a certain period of time or when the skill button is released. Adds the amount of reduced damage received from enemies while the skill is active to the damage dealt to enemies. However, any damage reduced by Trait effects will not be added. Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP. This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit. Attack ignores obstacles. Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time. Acquires DEF debuff effect at Level 5.
